'''Rulo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
After being discovered as [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Rulo was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] at one of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Jedi academy|academies]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]; eventually ascending to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. Assigned to the [[Almas Academy|experimental academy]] on [[Almas]], Jedi Rulo selected as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] the [[Human/Legends|Human]], [[Lo Pelkar]]. The team worked out of the academy together, accepting missions from the [[Almas Council]] that were nearly exclusively related to activity in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].<ref name="LFC" />

In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Jedi Rulo and Padawan Pelkar were dispatched to investigate the mass [[kaluthin]]-kill. Kaluthin, an [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]-giving growth that kept Almas habitable, was quickly dying around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from unnatural causes. Their search brought them to a local bar called [[Building 49-A]] where they discovered the local belief was that the Jedi were responsible. Biting their tongues, the Jedi were able to track down the true culprits: the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Kosa-Yin Hadu]] and [[Gar Granga]]. After engaging the two Dark Jedi, Rulo and Pelkar were able to subdue their enemy and end the crisis.<ref name="LFC" />
